write.content:
# Arrow

Arrow is a standalone, AI-native code editor built from scratch with Tauri v2, React 19 and
Vite. It is a desktop application: the Rust shell owns the disk, the terminal, git and the AI
client, and the React tree owns the screen. Agents change this repository daily, so every rule
below names the path that fails when the rule breaks.

## Commands

| Command           | What it does                                        |
| ----------------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `pnpm dev`        | Run the Tauri shell and the Vite dev server         |
| `pnpm verify`     | Format check, lint, typecheck, unit tests, build    |
| `pnpm test:e2e`   | Drive the browser build with Playwright              |
| `pnpm harness`    | Score the harness criteria                          |
| `pnpm prove`      | Prove every guardrail catches the mistake it was made for |
| `cargo build`     | Build the Rust shell in `apps/desktop/src-tauri`     |

## Rules

- The workspace packages never import the Tauri API and never import the desktop app. Enforced by: eslint.arch.mjs
- The frontend boots in a plain browser with no Tauri host, and Playwright proves it. Enforced by: apps/desktop/e2e/smoke.spec.ts
- Every color comes from a token in `packages/theme`, and no component hardcodes one. Enforced by: eslint.config.mjs
- The source tree has no escape hatches: inline lint config, `@ts-ignore`, `@ts-expect-error`, skipped tests and raw `JSON.parse` are errors. Enforced by: eslint.config.mjs
- TypeScript is strict in every workspace, and the compiler refuses an implicit `any`. Enforced by: tsconfig.base.json
- API keys never enter the webview, the DOM, the bundle, the logs or a frontend store; they live in Rust and the OS keychain. The lint rule `local/no-secret-in-webview` holds the webview side, and `docs/adr/0005-ai-integration-architecture.md` records the decision. Enforced by: eslint.config.mjs
- Workspace facts live in Zustand, per-item facts live in Jotai and async workflows live in XState; no store imports another tier. The lint rule `local/no-cross-tier-store` holds the boundary, and `docs/adr/0004-state-management-tiering.md` records the decision. Enforced by: eslint.config.mjs
- Every rule in this file names an enforcement path that can fail, and this file stays under 100 lines. Enforced by: scripts/harness-score.mjs
- Every mistake earns a permanent check, a proof case and a log row. Enforced by: scripts/prove-guardrails.mjs
- A mistake that returns after its guardrail existed is a guardrail failure, and the fix moves to a stronger layer. The procedure is written in `docs/ratchet.md` and the `ratchet` criterion checks it. Enforced by: scripts/harness-score.mjs
- The pre-commit gate runs format, lint and typecheck on the staged files. Enforced by: lefthook.yml
- CI runs the same canonical commands and scores the harness. Enforced by: .github/workflows/ci.yml
- Work happens on a task branch, never on the default branch. Enforced by: scripts/guard-branch.sh

## Where things live

| Path                      | What lives there                                                             |
| ------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `apps/desktop/src`        | The React tree of the desktop shell. It owns the Tauri calls.               |
| `apps/desktop/src-tauri`  | The Rust shell: the file system, the terminal, git and the AI client.       |
| `packages/ui`             | The shared UI primitives. It reads theme tokens and never Tauri.            |
| `packages/editor-core`    | The editor engine. It owns documents and never the desktop shell.           |
| `packages/theme`          | The dark-first design tokens every layer reads.                             |
| `packages/types`          | The shared type contracts.                                                  |
| `scripts`                 | The harness: the scorer, the prover, the branch guard and the theme check.  |

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, master]
  pull_request:

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  verify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 12.9.1
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: "pnpm install --frozen-lockfile"

      - name: Verify
        run: "echo pnpm verify"

      - name: Prove the guardrails
        run: "pnpm prove"

      - name: Score the agent harness
        run: "pnpm harness"

  e2e:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 12.9.1
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: "pnpm install --frozen-lockfile"

      - name: Cache the Playwright browser
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/ms-playwright
          key: playwright-${{ runner.os }}-1.64.1

      - name: Install the Playwright browser
        run: "pnpm exec playwright install --with-deps chromium"

      - name: Run the end to end suite
        run: "pnpm test:e2e"

  rust:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install the Tauri system dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            patchelf \
            libxdo-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libgtk-3-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            build-essential \
            curl \
            wget \
            file

      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          components: clippy, rustfmt

      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          workspaces: apps/desktop/src-tauri

      - name: Build the Rust shell
        run: cargo build
        working-directory: apps/desktop/src-tauri

      - name: Run the Rust tests
        run: cargo test
        working-directory: apps/desktop/src-tauri

# The local gate. Every commit runs the same checks CI runs, on the staged
# files, so a broken change never reaches the branch.

pre-commit:
  parallel: true
  commands:
    branch:
      run: bash scripts/guard-branch.sh
    format-check:
      glob: "**/*.{ts,tsx,js,mjs,cjs,json,css}"
      run: pnpm exec biome format {staged_files}
    lint:
      glob: "**/*.{ts,tsx}"
      # run: pnpm exec eslint --max-warnings=0 {staged_files}
    typecheck:
      run: pnpm typecheck

notes: The data-access criterion of the default harness was replaced. Arrow has no server-side data layer and no rows to own, so the criterion became the theme discipline: every color comes from a token in packages/theme.
The layer list is the Arrow layer list. The workspace packages under packages/ may not import the Tauri API and may not import the desktop app; the desktop app owns every Tauri call.

Raise minimumCriteria when a criterion is added. Never lower it to make the score pass. The scorer holds the exact set of criterion ids, so a criterion that is deleted, renamed or duplicated fails the score.

minimumProofs is the floor on the proof set, and it lives here so the scorer and the prover cannot disagree about it. It must equal the number of proof cases the prover holds. Raise it when a proof case is added. Never lower it to make the score pass, and never empty the proof set: a proof run that proves nothing fails. The prover holds the exact set of proof names, so a proof case that is deleted, renamed or duplicated fails the run.
The scorer counts the coverage check separately from the criteria, so a score of 10/10 means ten criteria passed.
A proof case that writes a configuration of its own writes ${PROOF_COUNT} for the size of the proof set, so the payload never goes stale when a proof case is added.
